description: Routine servicing, mechanical repair, component replacement, and diagnostic troubleshooting of internal combustion two-wheelers and light motor vehicles in independent roadside garages.
daily_tasks: Draining used engine motor oil and changing spin-on oil filters
Cleaning, de-carbonizing, and gapping spark plugs (0.7-0.9 mm)
Replacing worn clutch friction plates and steel pressure plates
Bleeding air bubbles from hydraulic disc brake lines
Adjusting valve tappet clearances with feeler gauges
Tensioning and lubricating motorcycle drive chains
advanced_tasks: Engine top-end overhaul (cylinder boring, piston rings, valve lapping)
Front telescopic hydraulic fork disassembly and oil seal replacement
Diagnosing complex electrical stator coil and CDI ignition misfires
Replacing rear differential crown-wheel and pinion gears
materials: Gasket paper and RTV silicone sealant
work_processes: Road Test Diagnosis -> Engine Oil Drain -> Filter Replacement -> Ignition / Carburetor Service -> Brake & Clutch Overhaul -> Valve Adjustment -> Final Road Test
troubleshooting_tasks: Differentiating between spark plug misfire, lean fuel starvation, and poor compression
Diagnosing spongy brake lever feel caused by trapped hydraulic air bubbles
Tracing engine overheating to lean carburetor pilot jet or slipping clutch
Identifying worn wheel bearings by checking radial free play on raised wheel
quality_inspection: Verifying correct engine oil dipstick level between Min and Max marks
Checking firm front brake lever resistance with zero lever creep
Confirming smooth clutch engagement without slippage under load
Verifying steady idle RPM (1400 +/- 100 RPM) without stalling
measurement_and_planning: Calibrating valve tappet clearances strictly to engine specs (0.05mm intake, 0.08mm exhaust)
Torquing cylinder head studs in diagonal star sequence
safety_practices: Supporting elevated chassis on mechanical jack stands (never hydraulic jack alone)
Catching waste motor oil in dedicated pans to prevent environmental spills
Wearing safety eye protection when spraying pressurized aerosol carburetor cleaner
Avoiding contact with hot exhaust headers during live engine tuning
maintenance: Greasing wheel axles and swingarm pivot bushings
Cleaning compressor intake air filter weekly
Refacing deformed mechanic hand spanners and chisels
customer_communication: Explaining preventive maintenance schedules to vehicle owners
Demonstrating worn clutch friction plates or blackened motor oil
Providing transparent component cost and labor repair estimates

official_vocational_references.dgt_cts_trade: Mechanic Motor Vehicle (CTS 017) / Mechanic Two & Three Wheeler (CTS 018)

canonical_skills: Motorcycle Engine Oil Drain and Replacement
Hydraulic Disc Brake Caliper Fluid Bleeding
Clutch Friction Plate Disassembly and Replacement
Carburetor Jet Cleaning and Air-Fuel Mixture Tuning
